items.t: Air suspension sags and the compressor wears out
items.job: Replace leaking air strut(s) and compressor
items.note: Euro Premium Parts puts the strut and compressor job at about $1,500-3,000. A compressor reseal kit costs far less if only the compressor is worn.

items.t: Timing belt failure bends the valves
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner, rollers and water pump
items.note: EuroAutoPro puts the belt job at about $1,000-2,000.

items.t: Timing chain and tensioner wear on the 4.2 FSI
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Euro Premium Parts gives about $1,000-2,500 for timing chain work; engine-out jobs at a dealer can cost more.

items.t: MMI screen freezes, dims or won't boot
Oil leaks from valve cover and camshaft seals
items.note: EuroAutoPro lists $200-600 for valve cover gaskets and $500-1,000 for camshaft seals.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts harshly or slips
items.job: Transmission fluid service and solenoid/leak repair
items.note: EuroAutoPro puts minor repairs at $300-800; a rebuild or replacement can exceed $5,000.

items.t: Plastic coolant pipe at the oil filter housing leaks
items.job: Replace coolant union pipe at oil filter housing
items.note: Owners report shop and dealer labor quotes of about $4,000.

items.t: Control arm bushings and ball joints wear
items.job: Replace front control arm(s) and align
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $800-930 per control arm job; several arms are often worn together. Alignment is extra.

items.t: Coolant pump leaks and coolant level drops
items.job: Replace coolant pump and clean contaminated vacuum parts
items.note: Owners in the lawsuit report $1,460-2,800 for the pump alone and nearly $6,000 with vacuum parts.

items.t: Oil leaks from the cylinder head cover
items.note: RepairPal's general A8 valve cover gasket estimate is about $730-1,060. May be covered under warranty via the bulletin.
